$comment: Sina Una spells. Descriptions pp.226-233 (PDF part 6, pp.1-8); class availability pp.224-225 (PDF part 5, pp.44-45). Chassis: D&D 5e 2014. Full rules text is summarised, not reproduced — see pageRef.

classLists.$comment: Which classes may take each Sina Una spell. 'babaylan' is a Sina Una class, not a PHB one.

spells.name: Lava Plume
spells.summary: A 5-foot fountain of lava bursts from the ground. Creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 fire damage.

spells.name: Spirit Dart
spells.summary: Ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage. Damage type is set by the nature spirit answering the call — roll or choose on the 1d6 spirit table.
spells.scaling: Extra darts at 5th, 11th, and 17th level, each rolled separately.

spells.name: Apolaki's Light
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, when damaged by a creature within 30 feet you can see
spells.summary: Solar light lashes back at your attacker. Constitution save or 1d12 radiant damage and blinded until the start of its next turn; half damage and no blinding on a success.

spells.name: Create or Harden Lava
components: M (a shard of obsidian to create, a chunk of volcanic rock to harden)
spells.summary: Melt a 10-foot cube of stone into lava (Dexterity save, 2d10 fire) or harden a 10-foot cube of lava into rock (Constitution save or restrained).
spells.scaling: Cube grows 5 feet per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: False Self
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, when subjected to the grappled or restrained condition
spells.summary: Swap places with an effigy of yourself, ending the grapple or restraint on you and transferring it to the effigy, which lasts until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Viper's Eyes
spells.summary: Target gains 60-foot blindsight via heat detection, but becomes vulnerable to sudden light or heat — on fire or radiant damage, a Constitution save (DC 10 or half damage taken, whichever is higher) or the spell ends early.

spells.name: Bonded Spirits
spells.summary: A local nature spirit bonds to a willing creature, granting +1 to all saving throws and an extra 1d6 damage on weapon attacks. Damage type set by the spirit table.

spells.name: Colors of Hanan
spells.summary: Draw a golden tattoo that the target can shift as a bonus action: Gold (+1 AC), Orange (attacks count as magical), Pink (regain 1d4+1 hit points at the start of their turn), Purple (advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saves).

spells.name: Lizard Skin
spells.summary: Target gains 5 temporary hit points and +1 AC, and can shed the skin as a reaction to end a grapple or restraint and move 5 feet.
spells.scaling: +5 temporary hit points per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Molten Shell
spells.summary: Fire resistance and 10 temporary hit points; melee attackers take 10 fire damage. Once the temporary hit points are gone the rock hardens, halving the damage of the next weapon attack that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.
spells.scaling: +5 temporary hit points and +5 fire damage per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Aqueous Affinity
spells.summary: Target gains a swimming speed equal to its movement, no longer has disadvantage on underwater weapon attacks, and has advantage on Dexterity saves while submerged.

spells.name: Coral Cage
spells.summary: Coral erupts around one creature. Dexterity save or 3d8 force damage and restrained. An aswang automatically fails, and repeats the save at disadvantage.

spells.name: Eruption
spells.summary: The ground explodes into molten rock. Creatures within 30 feet make a Dexterity save, taking 4d6 fire plus 4d6 thunder damage. Leaves a 30-foot radius of difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Shape Light
components: M (a visible light source and a shard of clear crystal)
spells.summary: Choose one manifestation: Moonlight (a weapon becomes magical, +1d8 radiant, wielder gains three-quarters cover), Starlight (a five-panel wall that penalises ranged attacks by 1d4 and deals 2d8 radiant), or Sunlight (a bright sphere dealing 3d8 radiant and blinding).

spells.name: Control Lava
spells.summary: Control molten lava in a 100-foot cube. Repeatable effects: Overflow (raise the lava up to 10 feet, 3d8 fire on entry), Part Lava (open a trench with walls to either side), or Redirect Lava Flow (send the flow in a chosen direction, 3d8 fire).

spells.name: Mayari's Embrace
spells.summary: A moonlight tattoo set to one lunar phase: Full (60-foot darkvision, advantage on Charisma checks and saves), Half (AC cannot be less than 16, bonus-action Dodge), Crescent (advantage on melee attacks, +15 feet speed), or New (bonus-action invisibility, immune to emotion and thought sensing).

spells.name: Ride Lightning
spells.summary: Summon and ride a lightning bolt to a point in range along the shortest path. Creatures in your path make a Dexterity save for 3d10 lightning damage. The movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

spells.name: Commune with Great Spirits
components: M (betel nut prepared to be shared)
spells.summary: Call a great spirit within 3 miles. Either ask up to three questions answered in a sentence or less, or request assistance with a natural phenomenon within the spirit's purview. Spirits can deceive, and larger requests risk unforeseen consequences.

spells.name: Tropical Paradise
components: M (a seed or pit of a tropical fruit)
spells.summary: A 15-foot grove of fruit trees springs up as a sheltered rest space for up to ten chosen creatures. Eating the fruit grants poison immunity and raises hit point maximum by 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier for 24 hours.

spells.name: Volcanic Wall
spells.summary: A ten-panel wall of lava. Dexterity save for 6d6 fire and knocked prone on appearance; the hot side deals 6d6 fire, the cold side is igneous rock with AC 15. Maintaining concentration for the full duration makes the wall permanent stone.

spells.name: Mist of the Moon Twins
spells.summary: Silver fog in a 30-foot radius, invoking the moon twins Bulan and Libulan. Up to eight chosen creatures see through it, gain 3d8 + spellcasting modifier temporary hit points on entering or starting a turn inside, and cause attacks against them to miss on a d100 roll of 60 or less.
spells.errata: Listed as 'Mischievous Mist of the Moon Twins' on the cleric and warlock spell lists, but 'Mist of the Moon Twins' in the description and on the bard and wizard lists.

spells.name: Cry of the Spirits
components: M (a delicate wood carving, or a bowl of food offerings)
spells.summary: A whirling 30-foot sphere of spirit power. Dexterity save for 12d6 force damage, and any creature dropped below ten times your spellcasting modifier in hit points by this spell is immediately incapacitated.

spells.name: Wrath of Lalahon
components: M (500 gp of gold and obsidian dust, consumed)
spells.summary: Your flesh becomes molten rock. Gain 10 × your spellcasting modifier in temporary hit points, immunity to acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder, an 8d6 fire aura affecting creatures within 30 feet at the start of your turn, and automatic success on concentration checks for fire or radiant spells.

spells.name: Celestial Chaos
spells.summary: Three 30-foot storms of moonbeams and solar flares. Initial Dexterity save for 12d12 radiant; thereafter a Constitution save on entering or starting a turn in a storm for 6d12 damage and blinding, with the damage type rolled on a d20 (even = fire, odd = cold). Up to eight creatures can be made immune.

notes: Ritual spells: Aqueous Affinity, Bonded Spirits, Colors of Hanan, Commune with Great Spirits, Mayari's Embrace, Tropical Paradise.
Concentration spells: Coral Cage, Control Lava, Shape Light, Volcanic Wall, Mist of the Moon Twins, Celestial Chaos.
Coral Cage singles out aswang: they auto-fail the initial save and repeat it at disadvantage.
The 'babaylan' spell list on p.224 belongs to a Sina Una class not yet extracted.
